newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash May soybeans follow CBOT down.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash May soybeans follow CBOT down.

text.p: Argentine soybeans slipped in low volume cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with prices slipping in the wake of lower Chicago soy, traders said.

Cash prices paid to farmers for May soybeans shed $4 to $249. April sunflower seed was dragged down after soybeans in slow trade, losing $2 to $202. Spot wheat trade was slow, with little supply. Bahia Blanca wheat rose $1 to $130. Weekend rains in the south have slowed deliveries. April maize was unchanged at $100 in quiet trade.
